title: AesDistill: Distilling Generative Aesthetics for Image Color Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2611.25635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Image color enhancement aims to improve visual appeal, but previous methods often learn to reproduce ground-truth expert targets. These targets reflect the preferences of a few experts and cover a limited range of aesthetic choices. Matching them does not ensure stronger aesthetic quality across different tastes and scenes. By contrast, large generative models learn rich visual knowledge from large image collections and often produce vivid, appealing image edits. However, direct generation can change the source image's semantic structure along with its colors. In this paper, we introduce AesDistill, a framework for distilling generative aesthetics into image color enhancement. We use 4 leading open-source large generative models to produce 64,644 edited images as teacher targets at a cost of about 3,360 H100 GPU-hours, forming the AesDistill Dataset. AesDistill also includes AesDistill Student, a 1.13M-parameter model that learns teach

translated_title: AesDistill：将生成式美学蒸馏用于图像色彩增强
translated_abstract: 图像色彩增强旨在提升图像的视觉吸引力，但以往的方法通常学习复现真值专家目标。这些目标反映的是少数专家的偏好，涵盖的美学选择范围有限，匹配它们并不能保证在不同品味和场景下都获得更强的美学质量。相比之下，大型生成模型从大规模图像集合中学习到了丰富的视觉知识，常常能生成生动、吸引人的图像编辑效果。然而，直接生成可能会在改变色彩的同时改变源图像的语义结构。在本文中，我们提出了AesDistill，一个将生成式美学蒸馏到图像色彩增强中的框架。我们使用4个领先的开源大型生成模型生成了64,644张编辑图像作为教师目标，耗费约3,360个H100 GPU小时，构成了AesDistill数据集。AesDistill还包含AesDistill Student，一个1.13M参数的模型，用于学习教师模型的知识。
tldr: 提出AesDistill框架，将大型生成模型的丰富美学知识蒸馏到仅1.13M参数的轻量级学生模型中，用于图像色彩增强，突破了传统方法依赖少数专家偏好目标的局限。
en_tdlr: AesDistill distills the rich aesthetics of large generative models into a lightweight 1.13M-parameter student model for image color enhancement, overcoming the limitations of prior methods that rely on a few experts' preference targets.
